title: 8.32. Oghadukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nooghaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… noyogaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe…. (Oghagocchakayogagocchakesu āmasanaṁ āsavagocchake āmasanasadisaṁ.)
Nonīvaraṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe…. (Nīvaraṇagocchake āmasanaṁ saññojanagocchake āmasanasadisaṁ.)
